summary: Surveyed all 1093 listed Lean files by directory (ArkLib/Data 545, ArkLib/ToMathlib 121, ArkLib/ProofSystem 91, ArkLib/OracleReduction 65, ArkLib/Commitments 64, ArkLib/Interaction 28, ArkLibTest 151, scripts 22, blueprint 1, ArkLib.lean umbrella) and by size extremes. A declaration grep over every file found 40 files with no top-level declaration keyword; the sampled ones are module-system import aggregators or re-export modules with module docstrings, `#print axioms` test files, and the blueprint root, all retained under FILTER-007/FD-016. ArkLibTest files hold concrete `example` proofs of library lemmas and stay searchable. The three compiled runtime harnesses in scripts (HachiRuntime, SumcheckRuntime, ToyProblemRuntime) contain theorems and concrete protocol instances and stay. Excluded are 18 scripts files, read completely: the repository QA executables and build-time lint plugin (AxiomSweep, LintStyle, LintStyle/Checks, RetiredProbabilitySweep, ArkLibLintPlugin) and their synthetic test fixtures.
